name: i inserts text before cursor
i on empty line inserts text
<BS> in insert deletes a typed character
a appends text after cursor
A appends text at end of line
I inserts before first non-blank
o opens a line below and inserts
O opens a line above and inserts
<CR> in middle of line splits it
<BS> at column 0 joins with previous line
<Tab> in insert inserts a tab character
insert accented character after cafe
3ia repeats inserted text three times
o on last line adds a new last line
a on empty line inserts at column 0
<Esc> after A leaves cursor on last inserted character
:w<CR> writes buffer without quitting
:q<CR> quits a clean buffer
:q! quits and discards edits
:wq<CR> writes and quits after an edit
:x<CR> on unmodified buffer quits
/foo<CR> jumps to next match
/foo<CR> wraps to top when no match after cursor
n repeats last search forward
N repeats last search backward
